chunks.title: Hero / Value Prop
chunks.text:
Headline: "Learn Today's Skills Build Tomorrow's Career" — Pakistan's Modern IT Learning Platform.
Sub-headline: Leaders Academia helps students, professionals and career-changers build practical, job-ready skills in web development, design, digital marketing and AI — through live classes, expert instructors and industry-recognised certification.
Primary CTA: "Explore Courses"  /courses
Secondary CTA: "Free Consultation"  /contact
Trust badges: Live Classes | Expert Trainers | Certificates | Career Guidance
Stat counters: Students / Teachers / Courses / Countries / Certificates (animated on load)

chunks.title: Core Features
chunks.text:
Expert Industry Instructors: All instructors bring real-world experience and certifications from leading tech companies/institutions.
Live One-on-One Sessions: Personal attention via HD live video sessions — no crowded classes, just student + dedicated instructor.
Flexible Scheduling: Book classes morning/evening/weekends; instructors available across multiple time zones.
Career & Freelancing Support: Guidance on portfolio building, freelancing (Upwork/Fiverr), and landing first IT job/client.
Progress Tracking: Real-time dashboards: skill progress, project milestones, attendance, weekly instructor feedback reports.
Certified Completion: Verifiable digital certificate per course; shareable on LinkedIn, downloadable PDF, unique QR code.

chunks.title: Live Class Tech
chunks.text:
Video Platforms: Google Meet and Zoom, both browser/app-based, no special software required.
HD Video & Audio: High-def video/screen sharing for real-time code/design correction.
In-Session Chat & Notes: Share code snippets/resources; instructors annotate on screen.
Session Recording: Classes can be recorded and saved to student account for later review.
Interactive Whiteboard: Used for explaining concepts, architecture, and workflows visually.
Min. Internet Speed: 2 Mbps recommended upload/download for smooth HD classes (audio-only fallback offered). [Live (per FAQ)]

chunks.title: Process
chunks.text:
How It Works (5 steps): 1) Register (free, <2 min) 2) Choose Course (200+ claimed) 3) Live Classes (1:1) 4) Assignments 5) Certificate
Admissions Flow: Apply Online (~3 min)  Team reviews & matches instructor (within 24 hrs)  Free trial class  Start Learning
Free Trial: Every new student gets a free 30-minute trial class, no credit card required.

chunks.title: Certification
chunks.text:
Auto-Generated: Certificate issued automatically upon course completion.
PDF Download: High-resolution PDF available to print or share.
Shareable Link: Shareable on LinkedIn, social media, or with family; includes QR code.

chunks.title: Company / About
chunks.text:
Founded: 2020 (per About page) — note: FAQ page states 2019, an inconsistency in source content.
Mission: Provide every learner worldwide access to experienced instructors for practical, job-ready IT skills, regardless of age/location/background.
Vision: Become the world's most trusted online IT training institution connecting students, instructors, and employers globally. [Live]
Scale Claimed: 2,500+ active students, 50+ countries served, 150+ instructors, 8 courses (About page stat block — inconsistent with 17 shown on /courses).
Core Values (6): Innovation, Integrity, Leadership, Professionalism, Practical Learning, Career Growth.
Company Timeline: 2020 Started  2021: 500 Students  2022: International Courses  2023: AI Learning  'What's Next: Future Vision'

Full Course: 2 months total: Month 1 structured classroom learning + Month 2 guided internship. Fee varies PKR 20,000–40,000 by course. Includes certificate + internship letter + career mentorship + priority support.
Skilled Based Trainings: Single fixed fee (no short/full split); PKR 7,900–8,000; 1-month format, Google Meet.
Payment Methods: Bank Transfer (UBL), Easypaisa, JazzCash, Debit/Credit Card (Online Card Payment = instant, recommended, no receipt upload).
Refund Policy: 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee stated on course pages / FAQ.
Scholarships: Scholarship program available for demonstrated financial need — apply via Contact page, reviewed confidentially.
